text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (Inside of me—lies a "wish"!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Three thousand years of Feng Shui 
history. The unchanging little wish that 
everyone has longed for! Namely—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Happiness! Just a little more happiness 
than yesterday! To prove that anyone can 
seize it!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Faster, stronger than anyone—to the very 
top of the heavens!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

The Yellow Dragon—ascended toward the 
heavens.

It was an overwhelming victory far beyond 
what met the eye. In this Tokyo Daishoten, 
Copano Rickey was unequivocally the 
undisputed champion.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp, wheeze, gasp*... Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, Tarumae? Did you see that? This is 
the true power of feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hype up the fans, lift up your peers, and 
then surpass everything to seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Did you all get that? Yes, as long as 
you're prepared like this, anyone— 
absolutely anyone—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It'll make you happy!! When in doubt, let 
feng shui give you courage~♪
(UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

"That day, what the fans witnessed was 
'hope.'"

Upon those who prepare the ground 
thoroughly and advance with unyielding 
will—heaven will surely smile.

It was also proof of three thousand years 
of philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey... That was just sheer skill, 
right? Not feng shui power or anything... 
But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~♪ Feels kind of wonderful, doesn't 
it, Rickey-chan, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To be surrounded by so many spectators at 
the end of the year and run such a fun 
race~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since my heart felt so 
warm and fuzzy. Thank you, Rickey-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see, I felt a little 
lonely~. The Umamusume who debuted with me 
started disappearing one by one. But..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Things are going to get fun again from 
here on out~ Since Rickey-chan and 
Tarumae-chan are both here with me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's keep running together, just 
the three of us, in this fulfilling place 
forever! Right, Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm not completely sold on 
feng shui power, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there really is something to this 
Ricky Power. Me, Acute-san, and the fans— 
everyone feels just a little bit more 
energized.

That was the highest praise Hokko Tarumae 
could give. And so, Copano Rickey went 
from the Four Gods to the strongest...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Still...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It's not over yet, Rickey. Our score 
isn't settled just yet!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'm going to get stronger and 
stronger! And for that—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run a proper race this time! In 
Dubai!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, Dubai...? Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just because I'm bad with distant places 
doesn't mean I can just back down in dead 
last, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If I eat properly and drink water, I 
should be able to run properly this time!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in Dubai, and I won't lose 
to Rickey either! I lost today, but I'll 
catch up to you next time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai power beats feng shui power! 
Next time, I'm definitely going to win, 
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... It looks like you've completely 
moved past your past.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's run together again next year♪
choice_data_list:
Ricky, it's the whole “Four Gods' 
Correspondence” thing again, huh?

Ricky, it's the whole “Four Gods' 
Correspondence” thing again, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I thought I broke away this time, 
but I just can't shake you off.”

As Copano Rickey grew stronger, those 
around her grew stronger too. Their 
relationship was truly harmonious.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll always make sure to stay a 
step ahead☆ Because I want to, and I know 
I can.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Continuing to bring hope through feng 
shui is our shared destiny, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You'll keep moving forward together with 
me forever for the sake of everyone's 
happiness, right, Trainer?

This was Copano Rickey's Lucky Road. And 
the one and only Twinkle Road she would 
dedicate her entire life to walking.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Let's keep our spirits aligned, 
never lose hope, and march straight 
forward☆
